findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext returns a fresh logger, discarding recorded logs
findings.body: `TestLogger.FromContext` returns `NewTestLogger()` instead of the receiver (or a logger sharing its `Logs` state). `LoggerMiddleware.logRequest` now emits its only log line via `m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...)`, so any test that injects a `*TestLogger` and then asserts on `InfoLogs.Calls`/`Message`/`Ctx` will observe zero calls, because the log is recorded on a throwaway instance. This makes the fake unusable for verifying the middleware's logging behaviour and will silently pass tests that are meant to catch regressions. Return `f` (or a logger that writes into the same `Logs` fields).

findings.title: New ContextualLoggerMiddleware is untested and the ordering dependency it creates is unguarded
findings.body: The log fields `pluginId`, `endpoint`, `dsName`, `dsUID`, `uname` and `traceID` were removed from `LoggerMiddleware.logRequest` and are now expected to come from contextual attributes injected by this new middleware (plus the tracing contextual log provider). No test exercises `ContextualLoggerMiddleware`, and no test asserts that the "Plugin Request Completed" log line still contains those fields. If this middleware is omitted from a chain, or ordered after `NewLoggerMiddleware` in `CreateMiddlewares`, every plugin egress log line silently loses all plugin/datasource/user identification and nothing fails. Add a test that runs the real middleware chain (or at least ContextualLogger + Logger) and asserts the emitted log parameters.

findings.title: Adding FromContext to the exported Logger interface breaks out-of-tree implementations
findings.body: `log.Logger` in `pkg/plugins/log` is an exported interface that is passed around the plugin management code (e.g. `NewLoggerMiddleware`). Adding the `FromContext(ctx context.Context) Logger` method is a breaking change for any implementation outside this package (Grafana Enterprise, other modules, custom fakes), which will fail to compile until updated. If these implementations exist, they must be updated in lockstep; consider documenting this in the PR or providing an embeddable default implementation.

findings.title: LoggerMiddleware still uses the stale "plugin.instrumentation" logger name
findings.body: After the rename, there is no instrumentation middleware any more, yet the logger handed to `NewLoggerMiddleware` is still created as `log.New("plugin.instrumentation")`, so every plugin egress log line is emitted with `logger=plugin.instrumentation`. This is misleading for anyone grepping logs for the middleware that produced them. If the name is kept for backwards compatibility with existing log queries/dashboards, that should be stated in a comment; otherwise rename it to match the middleware.

findings.title: Test function name not renamed along with the middleware
findings.body: The file and the type under test were renamed to `MetricsMiddleware`/`metrics_middleware_test.go`, but the test is still called `TestInstrumentationMiddleware`. Since the whole point of the PR is consistent naming, leaving the old name makes the test harder to locate by name (`go test -run TestMetricsMiddleware` finds nothing).
